subject: CLAIM lowering-opus B1 (per root decision): compute_frontend.m -commit, TeguCommand ivars (2 new), teguExecute early-scheduled/throttle block and the tail.asyncSeq site (retire); bridge n2mb_surface_reserve/retire (mine)
body: B1: at commit (CA's thread) an eligible pipelined command (async bridge, pipeline A/B on, no shadow write-back) takes the depth-2 throttle, RESERVEs (0112) the imported surfaces its jobs write, and is reported scheduled immediately; the executor thread submits, then RETIREs with the command's newest job id (0 = cancel on failure). Pre-0112 kernel / refused / >8 surfaces: today's behaviour (scheduled after the last submit). NORD2_METAL_EARLY_COMMIT=0 disables (A/B).
